verdict.rationale: Qodo generates AI-driven insights directly from a team's code/PR data — automated PR reviews with findings ranked by severity, rationale and fixes, blast-radius/risk classification, and code governance history/health views — all surfaced inside the product's own UI and PR provider integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality beyond vendor docs, and no evidence of broader dataset-wide analytics beyond code/PR context.
